mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cdc_change_log (mapping_id, source_table, operation, target_type, success, error_message, raw_data_json, cost_ms, replay_count, last_replay_at) VALUES (#{mappingId}, #{sourceTable}, #{operation}, #{targetType}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{rawDataJson}, #{costMs}, #{replayCount}, #{lastReplayAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, mapping_id, source_table, operation, target_type, success, error_message, raw_data_json, cost_ms, replay_count, last_replay_at, created_at FROM cdc_change_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

where.if: AND (mapping_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR source_table LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR operation LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT id, mapping_id, source_table, operation, target_type, success, error_message, raw_data_json, cost_ms, replay_count, last_replay_at, created_at FROM cdc_change_log WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE cdc_change_log SET replay_count = replay_count + 1, last_replay_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
